r3-blend-math.title: Check 3: Blend math + sign
r3-blend-math.imperative: Verify pi'=(1-a)z(pi)+a*z(-anchor). Anchor negated. alpha=0 exact no-op. alpha=1 = z(-anchor). Re-derive 3-driver ordering flip example. Confirm test asserts ordering flip.
r3-blend-math.finding: Formula in quali_pace_anchor.py line 100: (1-alpha)*z_pi + alpha*z_neg_anchor. Anchor negated at line 90 (neg_anchor=-anchor). alpha=0: early return line 71 — pi returned unchanged (exact no-op). alpha=1: returns z(-anchor) ordering. Manual derivation: pi=[0,1,2], anchor=[80,79,85]s; at alpha=1: z(-anchor)=[0.508,0.889,-1.397] so driver B (79s=fastest pace) gets pi'=0.889=highest. Head had C fastest — ordering flipped to B. TestAlphaOneContract.test_alpha_one_ordering_matches_neg_anchor asserts pairwise_sign_acc==1 vs neg_anchor. test_anchor_attach_point_inside_run_stage_pre_fusion asserts LEC(80s)->highest pi when alpha=1, VER(90s)->lowest — ordering flip confirmed.
